description: This file defines the SubSetMatcher class which provides static methods for checking if a subset of entries is contained within a superset, using regex matching and handling optional and negated entries.

classes.name: SubSetMatcher
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to check subset containment with regex matching, considering optional and negated entries.

methods.name: containsSubset
methods.description: Checks if the subset is contained within the superset considering regex matches, optional, and negation flags.

methods.name: matchesIndexes
methods.description: Finds indexes in the list where the matcher item matches both key and value using regex.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if any item in the list matches the given matcher item's key.

methods.name: nottedAndPresent
methods.description: Determines if a negated key in the matcher is present in the list.
